fee_notes: Base fee is $49,900 nonrefundable. Discounts available: 10% veteran discount; multi-unit discount of $10,000 (franchise 2) or $15,000 (franchise 3+). Territory fee of $0–$16,633 charged separately based on population over 330,000. Additional $500 training fee per trainee exceeding 3 attendees.
raw_excerpt: You pay us a nonrefundable $49,900 initial franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
